CFML Language Reference: Functions

QueryAddColumn

Adds a new column to a query and puts the elements of a one-dimensional array into it, one element per row.

Category

Query functions

Syntax

QueryAddColumn(query, column_name, array_name)

Parameters

query
A query, from QueryNew or CFQUERY.
column_name
Name of the new column.
array_name
A one-dimensional array with the values for the column.

Returns

The number of the new column (its position in the column list).

Usage

If the array has more elements than the query has rows, rows are added; the other columns are empty in those rows. If it has fewer, the remaining rows get empty values.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Movies = QueryNew("Title")>
<CFSET Temp = QueryAddRow(Movies, 3)>
<CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(Movies, "Title", "The Matrix", 1)>
<CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(Movies, "Title", "Toy Story 2", 2)>
<CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(Movies, "Title", "The Phantom Menace", 3)>

<CFSET Stars = ListToArray("4,5,3")>
<CFSET ColNum = QueryAddColumn(Movies, "Rating", Stars)>

<CFOUTPUT><P>Rating is column #ColNum#. Columns: #Movies.ColumnList#</P></CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Title</TH><TH>Rating</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Movies">
<TR><TD>#Title#</TD><TD>#RepeatString("*", Rating)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

See also

QueryNew, QueryAddRow, QuerySetCell
